briefing: Markets were roughly flat-to-down today (NASDAQ -0.9%, S&P 500 -0.8%), a neutral session with no clear risk-on catalyst. Rather than force capital into the market broadly, we made one targeted buy in ALVO, the only candidate showing all four confirmation signals (RSI, MACD crossover, momentum, and volume) at once; existing positions were held unchanged.

daily_lesson.explanation_en: Signal confluence means waiting for multiple independent indicators — like RSI, MACD, price trend, and volume — to all point the same direction before acting, rather than relying on just one. It reduces the chance of chasing a false signal, especially on days when the overall market isn't giving a clear direction.
daily_lesson.explanation_zh: 訊號共振是指等待多個獨立指標（如RSI、MACD、價格趨勢與成交量）同時指向同一方向後才進場，而非僅依賴單一訊號。這樣可以降低追高殺低、誤判假訊號的風險，尤其是在大盤方向不明確的日子裡更為重要。

market_education.summary_en: Major indices drifted slightly lower today with no single dominant catalyst, reflecting a pause after recent moves rather than a shift in sentiment. Trading volume across most names was unremarkable, consistent with a consolidation day rather than broad risk-off selling. A handful of individual stocks, like ALVO, still showed strong technical setups even as the broader market stayed flat.
market_education.summary_zh: 今日大盤指數小幅下跌，並無單一主導因素，較像是近期漲勢後的整理，而非市場情緒轉向風險趨避。多數個股成交量平淡，顯示屬於盤整日而非全面拋售。不過部分個股如ALVO在大盤持平的情況下，仍展現出強勁的技術面訊號。

trades.reasoning: All four confirmation signals align (RSI 66.3 in bullish zone, MACD bullish crossover with rising histogram, price above SMA-20, and a volume surge), indicating genuine institutional buying despite a flat-to-slightly-negative broader market.
